title: Remove the five unused create-next-app starter SVGs from public/

source.ref: Image cleanup 2026-11-02 (owner: clean up old images, delete nothing active)

verify.note: Fails before the change: the five starter files exist.

detail: Full image sweep of public/ (607 files). Everything else is active: referenced by code, built by a path helper (theme shots, Alli Rae, Temple, Network kit, email heroes), or listed in the library_assets table (nine /images/site photos have no code reference but are live photo-library rows). Deleted only file.svg, globe.svg, next.svg, vercel.svg, window.svg: no reference in code, scripts, manifest, service worker, docs-as-code, or any text/json column in the database. Kept on purpose, unreferenced but possibly hotlinked from sent email or external pages: public/images/Frequency-Logo-Round-Icon.png and public/brand/wildheart/wildheart-figure.svg. Kept because LIVE-1671 requires them byte for byte: the Network kit placeholder PNGs.
